**Article Details for PMID: 41243354**

**Title:** Expanding indications and developmental landscape of HER2-targeted therapies in breast cancer: a pharmacotherapeutic perspective.

**Authors:** Hikari Sano, Hideyuki Hayashi, Naomi Nakao, Hiroko Hosoi, Shunsuke Kondo

**Journal:** Expert opinion on pharmacotherapy
**Publication Date:** 2025-12-26
**DOI:** 10.1080/14656566.2025.2591813

**Abstract:**
This review provides an updated overview of the evolving pharmacologic landscape of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-targeted therapies in breast cancer, highlighting key clinical trial data, recent indication expansions, resistance mechanisms, and emerging therapeutic agents in development.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
